title: BRUME ÉTERNELLE : Le Dernier Gardien de Sainte-Rowan

one_sheet.title: BRUME ÉTERNELLE : Le Dernier Gardien de Sainte-Rowan
one_sheet.story_summary: À Fogmere, Mara Lenoir, gardienne de 22 ans, voit la Brume Verte réveiller les morts du cimetière de Sainte-Rowan à minuit. Armée de sa lanterne solaire et de pièges récupérés sur place, elle doit protéger le Mausolée Central pendant 12 nuits pour refermer le Sceau brisé. Chaque aube survivée révèle un nom gravé sur le Sceau — et le secret de sa propre famille.
gameplay_modes: Campagne 12 Nuits : survivez à des vagues de 15 à 120 zombies en 8 à 12 minutes par nuit, explorez 5 zones (Allée des Ifs, Crypte Inondée, Chapelle, Jardin des Statues, Mausolée Central), récupérez ferraille et huile, puis construisez défenses entre chaque aube.

Nuit Sans Fin : horde infinie avec brume épaississant toutes les 90 secondes, score, combo de lanternes et classement en ligne ; débloquez 18 améliorations permanentes et 6 lanterneaux aux effets uniques.
usps: Brume vivante en Godot 4 : la visibilité passe de 40 m à 6 m selon le vent, votre lanterne repousse le brouillard en cône de 120° mais sa batterie de 90 secondes force à gérer 4 bornes de recharge disputées par les zombies.

Défenses combinables : placez barricades de bancs, pièges à fosse, cloches distrayantes et tourelles à eau bénite pour créer 27 synergies, comme Cloche + Fosse qui attire et immobilise 8 ennemis pendant 5 secondes.

6 ennemis aux règles claires : Rampant lent, Coureur phosphorescent attiré par la lumière, Brute Funéraire à 300 PV brisant les barricades, Hurleur réveillant les tombes à 15 m, Fouisseur surgissant sous vos pieds et Porteur de Lanterne volant votre huile.

gdd.visual_style_prompt: Hand-painted 2D survival game key art, top-down slightly angled view of a foggy Victorian cemetery at midnight, a young guardian in a yellow raincoat holding a warm glowing solar lantern, teal-green rolling mist parting in a cone of golden light, crooked tombstones, weeping willows, iron fences, a stone chapel and central mausoleum, stylized shadowy zombie silhouettes with soft glowing green eyes emerging playfully from the fog, cozy-spooky atmosphere, rich contrast between cold blue night and warm lantern light, detailed Godot 2D lighting, family-friendly spooky, no graphic details

code.code_content:
extends CharacterBody3D
class_name PlayerController

signal health_changed(current_health: float, max_health: float)
signal ammo_changed(current_ammo: int, reserve_ammo: int)
signal wave_started(wave_number: int)
signal zombie_killed(total_kills: int)
signal player_died(final_score: int)

const GRAVITY: float = 22.0
const ZOMBIE_LAYER: int = 2
const WORLD_LAYER: int = 1
const ARENA_RADIUS: float = 54.0

@export var walk_speed: float = 5.5
@export var sprint_speed: float = 8.5
@export var crouch_speed: float = 2.8
@export var acceleration: float = 14.0
@export var jump_velocity: float = 7.5
@export var mouse_sensitivity: float = 0.0022
@export var max_health: float = 100.0
@export var max_stamina: float = 100.0
@export var stamina_drain: float = 22.0
@export var stamina_regen: float = 16.0
@export var weapon_damage: float = 34.0
@export var headshot_multiplier: float = 2.0
@export var weapon_range: float = 100.0
@export var magazine_size: int = 30
@export var fire_rate: float = 8.0
@export var reload_duration: float = 1.6

var health: float
var stamina: float
var current_ammo: int
var reserve_ammo: int
var score: int = 0
var kills: int = 0
var wave_number: int = 0
var is_dead: bool = false
var is_reloading: bool = false
var is_sprinting: bool = false

var _yaw: float = 0.0
var _pitch: float = 0.0
var _fire_cooldown: float = 0.0
var _reload_timer: float = 0.0
var _spawn_timer: float = 0.0
var _intermission_timer: float = 0.0
var _zombies_to_spawn: int = 0
var _zombies_spawned_this_wave: int = 0
var _wave_in_progress: bool = false
var _muzzle_timer: float = 0.0
var _damage_flash_alpha: float = 0.0
var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

var _zombies: Array[Dictionary] = []

var _head: Node3D
var _camera: Camera3D
var _muzzle_light: OmniLight3D
var _hud_layer: CanvasLayer
var _health_bar: ProgressBar
var _stamina_bar: ProgressBar
var _ammo_label: Label
var _wave_label: Label
var _score_label: Label
var _message_label: Label
var _game_over_label: Label
var _damage_flash: ColorRect
var _crosshair: Label


func _ready() -> void:
	_rng.randomize()
	health = max_health
	stamina = max_stamina
	current_ammo = magazine_size
	reserve_ammo = 240
	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = WORLD_LAYER | ZOMBIE_LAYER
	_ensure_input_actions()
	_ensure_player_body()
	_build_foggy_environment()
	_build_cemetery()
	_build_hud()
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	_update_hud()
	_start_next_wave()


func _ensure_input_actions() -> void:
	_add_key_action("move_forward", KEY_W)
	_add_key_action("move_forward", KEY_Z)
	_add_key_action("move_back", KEY_S)
	_add_key_action("move_left", KEY_A)
	_add_key_action("move_left", KEY_Q)
	_add_key_action("move_right", KEY_D)
	_add_key_action("sprint", KEY_SHIFT)
	_add_key_action("jump", KEY_SPACE)
	_add_key_action("crouch", KEY_CTRL)
	_add_key_action("crouch", KEY_C)
	_add_key_action("reload", KEY_R)
	_add_key_action("restart", KEY_ENTER)
	_add_mouse_action("shoot", MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)


func _add_key_action(action_name: StringName, keycode: Key) -> void:
	if not InputMap.has_action(action_name):
		InputMap.add_action(action_name)
	for event in InputMap.action_get_events(action_name):
		if event is InputEventKey and event.physical_keycode == keycode:
			return
	var key_event := InputEventKey.new()
	key_event.physical_keycode = keycode
	InputMap.action_add_event(action_name, key_event)


func _add_mouse_action(action_name: StringName, button_index: MouseButton) -> void:
	if not InputMap.has_action(action_name):
		InputMap.add_action(action_name)
	for event in InputMap.action_get_events(action_name):
		if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == button_index:
			return
	var mouse_event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	mouse_event.button_index = button_index
	InputMap.action_add_event(action_name, mouse_event)


func _ensure_player_body() -> void:
	if get_node_or_null("CollisionShape3D") == null:
		var shape_node := CollisionShape3D.new()
		shape_node.name = "CollisionShape3D"
		var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
		capsule.radius = 0.38
		capsule.height = 1.8
		shape_node.shape = capsule
		shape_node.position.y = 0.9
		add_child(shape_node)
	_head = get_node_or_null("Head") as Node3D
	if _head == null:
		_head = Node3D.new()
		_head.name = "Head"
		_head.position.y = 1.62
		add_child(_head)
	_camera = _head.get_node_or_null("Camera3D") as Camera3D
	if _camera == null:
		_camera = Camera3D.new()
		_camera.name = "Camera3D"
		_camera.fov = 75.0
		_camera.near = 0.05
		_camera.far = 180.0
		_head.add_child(_camera)
	_camera.current = true
	_muzzle_light = OmniLight3D.new()
	_muzzle_light.name = "MuzzleFlash"
	_muzzle_light.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.35)
	_muzzle_light.light_energy = 0.0
	_muzzle_light.omni_range = 7.0
	_muzzle_light.position = Vector3(0.25, -0.18, -0.7)
	_camera.add_child(_muzzle_light)


func _build_foggy_environment() -> void:
	var world_environment := WorldEnvironment.new()
	world_environment.name = "FoggyCemeteryEnvironment"
	var environment := Environment.new()
	environment.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	environment.background_color = Color(0.025, 0.035, 0.045)
	environment.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	environment.ambient_light_color = Color(0.28, 0.34, 0.42)
	environment.ambient_light_energy = 0.45
	environment.fog_enabled = true
	environment.fog_mode = Environment.FOG_MODE_EXPONENTIAL
	environment.fog_light_color = Color(0.58, 0.64, 0.70)
	environment.fog_light_energy = 0.55
	environment.fog_density = 0.045
	environment.fog_sky_affect = 0.65
	environment.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAP_ACES
	environment.adjustment_enabled = true
	environment.adjustment_brightness = 0.82
	environment.adjustment_contrast = 1.08
	world_environment.environment = environment
	add_child(world_environment)
	var moon := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	moon.name = "MoonLight"
	moon.light_color = Color(0.62, 0.72, 0.90)
	moon.light_energy = 0.55
	moon.shadow_enabled = true
	moon.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48.0, -28.0, 0.0)
	add_child(moon)
	var lantern := OmniLight3D.new()
	lantern.name = "PlayerLantern"
	lantern.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.55)
	lantern.light_energy = 1.1
	lantern.omni_range = 11.0
	lantern.omni_attenuation = 1.2
	lantern.position.y = 1.5
	add_child(lantern)


func _build_cemetery() -> void:
	var cemetery := Node3D.new()
	cemetery.name = "FoggyCemetery"
	add_sibling.call_deferred(cemetery)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(cemetery):
		return
	var ground_body := StaticBody3D.new()
	ground_body.name = "Ground"
	ground_body.collision_layer = WORLD_LAYER
	ground_body.collision_mask = 0
	cemetery.add_child(ground_body)
	var ground_mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var plane := PlaneMesh.new()
	plane.size = Vector2(ARENA_RADIUS * 2.4, ARENA_RADIUS * 2.4)
	ground_mesh_instance.mesh = plane
	var ground_material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	ground_material.albedo_color = Color(0.08, 0.13, 0.07)
	ground_material.roughness = 1.0
	ground_mesh_instance.material_override = ground_material
	ground_body.add_child(ground_mesh_instance)
	var ground_collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var world_box := WorldBoundaryShape3D.new()
	ground_collision.shape = world_box
	ground_body.add_child(ground_collision)
	_create_perimeter(cemetery)
	for i in 90:
		_create_tombstone(cemetery, i)
	for i in 18:
		_create_dead_tree(cemetery, i)
	for i in 26:
		_create_grass_patch(cemetery, i)


func _create_perimeter(parent: Node3D) -> void:
	var positions: Array[Vector3] = [
		Vector3(0.0, 2.0, -ARENA_RADIUS),
		Vector3(0.0, 2.0, ARENA_RADIUS),
		Vector3(-ARENA_RADIUS, 2.0, 0.0),
		Vector3(ARENA_RADIUS, 2.0, 0.0)
	]
	for i in positions.size():
		var wall := StaticBody3D.new()
		wall.collision_layer = WORLD_LAYER
		wall.collision_mask = 0
		wall.position = positions[i]
		parent.add_child(wall)
		var collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
		var box := BoxShape3D.new()
		box.size = Vector3(ARENA_RADIUS * 2.0, 5.0, 1.0) if i < 2 else Vector3(1.0, 5.0, ARENA_RADIUS * 2.0)
		collision.shape = box
		wall.add_child(collision)
		var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var box_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
		box_mesh.size = box.size
		mesh_instance.mesh = box_mesh
		var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		material.albedo_color = Color(0.10, 0.10, 0.12)
		material.roughness = 0.95
		mesh_instance.material_override = material
		wall.add_child(mesh_instance)


func _random_arena_position(min_radius: float, max_radius: float) -> Vector3:
	var angle := _rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	var radius := _rng.randf_range(min_radius, max_radius)
	return Vector3(cos(angle) * radius, 0.0, sin(angle) * radius)


func _create_tombstone(parent: Node3D, index: int) -> void:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "Tombstone_%d" % index
	body.collision_layer = WORLD_LAYER
	body.collision_mask = 0
	body.position = _random_arena_position(5.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 5.0)
	body.rotation.y = _rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	parent.add_child(body)
	var height := _rng.randf_range(0.8, 1.7)
	var collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var box := BoxShape3D.new()
	box.size = Vector3(0.85, height, 0.22)
	collision.shape = box
	collision.position.y = height * 0.5
	body.add_child(collision)
	var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	box_mesh.size = box.size
	mesh_instance.mesh = box_mesh
	mesh_instance.position.y = height * 0.5
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	var shade := _rng.randf_range(0.28, 0.48)
	material.albedo_color = Color(shade, shade, shade * 1.08)
	material.roughness = 1.0
	mesh_instance.material_override = material
	body.add_child(mesh_instance)
	var label := Label3D.new()
	label.text = "R.I.P."
	label.font_size = 42
	label.modulate = Color(0.65, 0.65, 0.62, 0.8)
	label.position = Vector3(0.0, height * 0.68, 0.13)
	label.pixel_size = 0.004
	body.add_child(label)


func _create_dead_tree(parent: Node3D, index: int) -> void:
	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "DeadTree_%d" % index
	body.collision_layer = WORLD_LAYER
	body.collision_mask = 0
	body.position = _random_arena_position(8.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 4.0)
	parent.add_child(body)
	var height := _rng.randf_range(3.2, 5.2)
	var collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cylinder := CylinderShape3D.new()
	cylinder.radius = 0.28
	cylinder.height = height
	collision.shape = cylinder
	collision.position.y = height * 0.5
	body.add_child(collision)
	var trunk := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var trunk_mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	trunk_mesh.top_radius = 0.12
	trunk_mesh.bottom_radius = 0.34
	trunk_mesh.height = height
	trunk.mesh = trunk_mesh
	trunk.position.y = height * 0.5
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = Color(0.09, 0.055, 0.035)
	material.roughness = 1.0
	trunk.material_override = material
	body.add_child(trunk)
	for branch_index in 3:
		var branch := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var branch_mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
		branch_mesh.top_radius = 0.025
		branch_mesh.bottom_radius = 0.07
		branch_mesh.height = _rng.randf_range(1.0, 1.8)
		branch.mesh = branch_mesh
		branch.material_override = material
		branch.position = Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-0.35, 0.35), height * _rng.randf_range(0.68, 0.92), _rng.randf_range(-0.35, 0.35))
		branch.rotation = Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-0.9, 0.9), 0.0, _rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.25))
		body.add_child(branch)


func _create_grass_patch(parent: Node3D, index: int) -> void:
	var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mesh_instance.name = "GrassPatch_%d" % index
	mesh_instance.position = _random_arena_position(2.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 2.0)
	var box_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	box_mesh.size = Vector3(_rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.6), 0.22, _rng.randf_range(0.7, 1.6))
	mesh_instance.mesh = box_mesh
	mesh_instance.position.y = 0.1
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = Color(0.10, 0.22, 0.08, 0.75)
	material.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mesh_instance.material_override = material
	parent.add_child(mesh_instance)


func _build_hud() -> void:
	_hud_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
	_hud_layer.name = "HUD"
	add_child(_hud_layer)
	_damage_flash = ColorRect.new()
	_damage_flash.color = Color(0.75, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
	_damage_flash.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_damage_flash.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_hud_layer.add_child(_damage_flash)
	_health_bar = _create_bar(Vector2(24.0, -64.0), Color(0.72, 0.10, 0.10))
	_stamina_bar = _create_bar(Vector2(24.0, -38.0), Color(0.15, 0.65, 0.30))
	_ammo_label = _create_label(Vector2(-224.0, -58.0), 30, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT)
	_wave_label = _create_label(Vector2(24.0, 20.0), 26, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)
	_score_label = _create_label(Vector2(-224.0, 20.0), 24, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT)
	_message_label = _create_label(Vector2(-400.0, 92.0), 30, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER)
	_message_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_TOP)
	_message_label.size = Vector2(800.0, 48.0)
	_game_over_label = _create_label(Vector2(-450.0, -90.0), 42, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER)
	_game_over_label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	_game_over_label.size = Vector2(900.0, 180.0)
	_game_over_label.visible = false
	_crosshair = Label.new()
	_crosshair.text = "+"
	_crosshair.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	_crosshair.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.85))
	_crosshair.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	_crosshair.position = Vector2(-10.0, -22.0)
	_crosshair.size = Vector2(20.0, 40.0)
	_crosshair.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_hud_layer.add_child(_crosshair)


func _create_bar(offset: Vector2, color: Color) -> ProgressBar:
	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.min_value = 0.0
	bar.max_value = 100.0
	bar.value = 100.0
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(280.0, 18.0)
	bar.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_LEFT)
	bar.position = offset
	var background := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	background.bg_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.65)
	background.corner_radius_top_left = 4
	background.corner_radius_top_right = 4
	background.corner_radius_bottom_left = 4
	background.corner_radius_bottom_right = 4
	var fill := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	fill.bg_color = color
	fill.corner_radius_top_left = 4
	fill.corner_radius_top_right = 4
	fill.corner_radius_bottom_left = 4
	fill.corner_radius_bottom_right = 4
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", background)
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", fill)
	_hud_layer.add_child(bar)
	return bar


func _create_label(offset: Vector2, font_size: int, alignment: HorizontalAlignment) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.92, 0.94, 0.96))
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.9))
	label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 2)
	label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 2)
	label.position = offset
	label.size = Vector2(200.0, 36.0)
	label.horizontal_alignment = alignment
	if offset.x < 0.0 and offset.y > 0.0:
		label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	elif offset.x < 0.0:
		label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_BOTTOM_RIGHT)
	_hud_layer.add_child(label)
	return label


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED and not is_dead:
		var motion := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		_yaw -= motion.relative.x * mouse_sensitivity
		_pitch = clampf(_pitch - motion.relative.y * mouse_sensitivity, deg_to_rad(-82.0), deg_to_rad(82.0))
		rotation.y = _yaw
		_head.rotation.x = _pitch
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE if Input.mouse_mode == Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED else Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and Input.mouse_mode != Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED and not is_dead:
		Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_dead:
		velocity = velocity.move_toward(Vector3.ZERO, acceleration * delta)
		move_and_slide()
		return
	_handle_movement(delta)
	_handle_weapon(delta)
	_update_wave(delta)
	_update_zombies(delta)
	_update_effects(delta)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if is_dead and Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
		get_tree().paused = false
		get_tree().reload_current_scene()


func _handle_movement(delta: float) -> void:
	var input_vector := Vector2.ZERO
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_forward"):
		input_vector.y -= 1.0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_back"):
		input_vector.y += 1.0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_left"):
		input_vector.x -= 1.0
	if Input.is_action_pressed("move_right"):
		input_vector.x += 1.0
	input_vector = input_vector.normalized()
	var wants_sprint := Input.is_action_pressed("sprint") and input_vector.y < 0.0 and stamina > 1.0
	is_sprinting = wants_sprint and is_on_floor()
	var target_speed := walk_speed
	if Input.is_action_pressed("crouch"):
		target_speed = crouch_speed
	elif is_sprinting:
		target_speed = sprint_speed
	if is_sprinting and input_vector.length() > 0.1:
		stamina = maxf(0.0, stamina - stamina_drain * delta)
	else:
		stamina = minf(max_stamina, stamina + stamina_regen * delta)
	var direction := (transform.basis * Vector3(input_vector.x, 0.0, input_vector.y)).normalized()
	var horizontal_velocity := Vector3(velocity.x, 0.0, velocity.z)
	horizontal_velocity = horizontal_velocity.move_toward(direction * target_speed, acceleration * delta * maxf(1.0, target_speed))
	velocity.x = horizontal_velocity.x
	velocity.z = horizontal_velocity.z
	if not is_on_floor():
		velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
	elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump") and not Input.is_action_pressed("crouch"):
		velocity.y = jump_velocity
	else:
		velocity.y = -0.5
	move_and_slide()
	global_position.x = clampf(global_position.x, -ARENA_RADIUS + 1.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 1.0)
	global_position.z = clampf(global_position.z, -ARENA_RADIUS + 1.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 1.0)
	if _camera != null:
		var bob_amount := 0.035 if input_vector.length() > 0.1 and is_on_floor() else 0.0
		_camera.position.y = lerpf(_camera.position.y, sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.012) * bob_amount, 0.18)


func _handle_weapon(delta: float) -> void:
	_fire_cooldown = maxf(0.0, _fire_cooldown - delta)
	if is_reloading:
		_reload_timer -= delta
		if _reload_timer <= 0.0:
			_finish_reload()
		return
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("reload"):
		_start_reload()
		return
	if Input.is_action_pressed("shoot") and _fire_cooldown <= 0.0:
		_shoot()


func _shoot() -> void:
	if current_ammo <= 0:
		_start_reload()
		return
	current_ammo -= 1
	_fire_cooldown = 1.0 / fire_rate
	_muzzle_timer = 0.055
	_muzzle_light.light_energy = 3.5
	ammo_changed.emit(current_ammo, reserve_ammo)
	var from := _camera.global_position
	var direction := -_camera.global_transform.basis.z.normalized()
	direction += Vector3(_rng.randf_range(-0.006, 0.006), _rng.randf_range(-0.006, 0.006), _rng.randf_range(-0.006, 0.006))
	direction = direction.normalized()
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from, from + direction * weapon_range)
	query.exclude = [get_rid()]
	query.collision_mask = WORLD_LAYER | ZOMBIE_LAYER
	var result := get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
	if not result.is_empty():
		var collider := result.get("collider") as Object
		var hit_position := result.get("position") as Vector3
		for zombie_data in _zombies:
			if zombie_data.get("node") == collider:
				var zombie_node := collider as Node3D
				var is_headshot := hit_position.y > zombie_node.global_position.y + 1.38
				_damage_zombie(zombie_data, weapon_damage * (headshot_multiplier if is_headshot else 1.0), is_headshot)
				break
	_update_hud()


func _start_reload() -> void:
	if is_reloading or current_ammo >= magazine_size or reserve_ammo <= 0:
		return
	is_reloading = true
	_reload_timer = reload_duration
	_show_message("Rechargement...")
	_update_hud()


func _finish_reload() -> void:
	var needed := magazine_size - current_ammo
	var loaded := mini(needed, reserve_ammo)
	current_ammo += loaded
	reserve_ammo -= loaded
	is_reloading = false
	ammo_changed.emit(current_ammo, reserve_ammo)
	_show_message("")
	_update_hud()


func _start_next_wave() -> void:
	wave_number += 1
	_zombies_to_spawn = 5 + wave_number * 3
	_zombies_spawned_this_wave = 0
	_spawn_timer = 0.5
	_wave_in_progress = true
	if wave_number > 1:
		health = minf(max_health, health + 25.0)
		reserve_ammo += 60 + wave_number * 10
		health_changed.emit(health, max_health)
		ammo_changed.emit(current_ammo, reserve_ammo)
	wave_started.emit(wave_number)
	_show_message("Vague %d - Ils arrivent..." % wave_number)
	_update_hud()


func _update_wave(delta: float) -> void:
	if _wave_in_progress:
		if _zombies_spawned_this_wave < _zombies_to_spawn:
			_spawn_timer -= delta
			var interval := clampf(1.4 - float(wave_number) * 0.07, 0.45, 1.4)
			if _spawn_timer <= 0.0:
				_spawn_zombie()
				_zombies_spawned_this_wave += 1
				_spawn_timer = interval
		elif _zombies.is_empty():
			_wave_in_progress = false
			_intermission_timer = 5.0
			score += 100 * wave_number
			_show_message("Vague terminée ! Bonus +%d" % (100 * wave_number))
			_update_hud()
	else:
		_intermission_timer -= delta
		if _intermission_timer <= 0.0:
			_start_next_wave()


func _spawn_zombie() -> void:
	var zombie := CharacterBody3D.new()
	zombie.name = "Zombie"
	zombie.collision_layer = ZOMBIE_LAYER
	zombie.collision_mask = WORLD_LAYER | ZOMBIE_LAYER | 1
	zombie.position = _random_arena_position(24.0, ARENA_RADIUS - 4.0)
	zombie.position.y = 1.0
	get_parent().add_child(zombie) if get_parent() != null else add_child(zombie)
	var collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.radius = 0.38
	capsule.height = 1.75
	collision.shape = capsule
	collision.position.y = 0.88
	zombie.add_child(collision)
	var body_mesh := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var capsule_mesh := CapsuleMesh.new()
	capsule_mesh.radius = 0.38
	capsule_mesh.height = 1.75
	body_mesh.mesh = capsule_mesh
	body_mesh.position.y = 0.88
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = Color(0.20, 0.42, 0.16)
	material.roughness = 0.9
	body_mesh.material_override = material
	zombie.add_child(body_mesh)
	var head := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sphere := SphereMesh.new()
	sphere.radius = 0.27
	sphere.height = 0.54
	head.mesh = sphere
	head.position.y = 1.92
	var head_material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	head_material.albedo_color = Color(0.48, 0.58, 0.34)
	head_material.emission_enabled = true
	head_material.emission = Color(0.35, 0.05, 0.02)
	head_material.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.35
	head.material_override = head_material
	zombie.add_child(head)
	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		var eye := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var eye_mesh := SphereMesh.new()
		eye_mesh.radius = 0.035
		eye_mesh.height = 0.07
		eye.mesh = eye_mesh
		eye.position = Vector3(0.10 * side, 1.98, -0.24)
		var eye_material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		eye_material.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.08, 0.03)
		eye_material.emission_enabled = true
		eye_material.emission = Color(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
		eye_material.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
		eye.material_override = eye_material
		zombie.add_child(eye)
	var zombie_health := 70.0 + float(wave_number) * 18.0
	var zombie_speed := _rng.randf_range(2.0, 3.1) + minf(1.4, float(wave_number) * 0.10)
	_zombies.append({
		"node": zombie,
		"health": zombie_health,
		"max_health": zombie_health,
		"speed": zombie_speed,
		"damage": 10.0 + float(wave_number) * 1.5,
		"attack_cooldown": 0.0,
		"wobble_phase": _rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	})
	_update_hud()


func _update_zombies(delta: float) -> void:
	for i in range(_zombies.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var data := _zombies[i]
		var zombie := data.get("node") as CharacterBody3D
		if not is_instance_valid(zombie):
			_zombies.remove_at(i)
			continue
		data["attack_cooldown"] = maxf(0.0, float(data.get("attack_cooldown")) - delta)
		var to_player := global_position - zombie.global_position
		to_player.y = 0.0
		var distance := to_player.length()
		var direction := to_player.normalized() if distance > 0.05 else Vector3.ZERO
		if distance > 1.25:
			var wobble := sin(Time.get_ticks_msec() * 0.004 + float(data.get("wobble_phase"))) * 0.25
			var side := Vector3(-direction.z, 0.0, direction.x) * wobble
			var velocity := (direction + side).normalized() * float(data.get("speed"))
			zombie.velocity.x = velocity.x
			zombie.velocity.z = velocity.z
		else:
			zombie.velocity.x = 0.0
			zombie.velocity.z = 0.0
			if float(data.get("attack_cooldown")) <= 0.0 and not is_dead:
				data["attack_cooldown"] = 0.9
				take_damage(float(data.get("damage")))
		if not zombie.is_on_floor():
			zombie.velocity.y -= GRAVITY * delta
		else:
			zombie.velocity.y = -0.5
		if distance > 0.1:
			zombie.look_at(Vector3(global_position.x, zombie.global_position.y, global_position.z), Vector3.UP)
		zombie.move_and_slide()
		_zombies[i] = data


func _damage_zombie(data: Dictionary, damage: float, is_headshot: bool) -> void:
	data["health"] = float(data.get("health")) - damage
	var zombie := data.get("node") as CharacterBody3D
	if float(data.get("health")) <= 0.0:
		kills += 1
		score += 150 if is_headshot else 100
		health = minf(max_health, health + 3.0)
		health_changed.emit(health, max_health)
		zombie_killed.emit(kills)
		if is_instance_valid(zombie):
			_create_death_burst(zombie.global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.1)
			zombie.queue_free()
		_zombies.erase(data)
	else:
		score += 10
		if is_instance_valid(zombie):
			zombie.global_position += -zombie.global_transform.basis.z * 0.08
	_update_hud()


func _create_death_burst(position: Vector3) -> void:
	var particles := GPUParticles3D.new()
	particles.amount = 18
	particles.one_shot = true
	particles.explosiveness = 0.9
	particles.lifetime = 0.65
	particles.emitting = true
	var process_material := ParticleProcessMaterial.new()
	process_material.direction = Vector3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)
	process_material.spread = 55.0
	process_material.initial_velocity_min = 1.5
	process_material.initial_velocity_max = 4.0
	process_material.gravity = Vector3(0.0, -5.0, 0.0)
	process_material.scale_min = 0.04
	process_material.scale_max = 0.11
	process_material.color = Color(0.35, 0.65, 0.20)
	particles.process_material = process_material
	var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
	mesh.radius = 0.06
	mesh.height = 0.12
	particles.draw_pass_1 = mesh
	get_parent().add_child(particles) if get_parent() != null else add_child(particles)
	particles.global_position = position
	var timer := get_tree().create_timer(0.9)
	timer.timeout.connect(particles.queue_free)


func take_damage(amount: float) -> void:
	if is_dead or amount <= 0.0:
		return
	health = maxf(0.0, health - amount)
	_damage_flash_alpha = 0.42
	health_changed.emit(health, max_health)
	_update_hud()
	if health <= 0.0:
		_die()


func heal(amount: float) -> void:
	if is_dead:
		return
	health = minf(max_health, health + amount)
	health_changed.emit(health, max_health)
	_update_hud()


func _die() -> void:
	is_dead = true
	player_died.emit(score)
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
	_crosshair.visible = false
	_game_over_label.text = "VOUS ÊTES MORT\nScore : %d   Zombies tués : %d\nVague atteinte : %d\n\nAppuyez sur Entrée pour recommencer" % [score, kills, wave_number]
	_game_over_label.visible = true
	_show_message("")


func _update_effects(delta: float) -> void:
	if _muzzle_timer > 0.0:
		_muzzle_timer -= delta
		if _muzzle_timer <= 0.0:
			_muzzle_light.light_energy = 0.0
	if _damage_flash_alpha > 0.0:
		_damage_flash_alpha = maxf(0.0, _damage_flash_alpha - delta * 1.6)
		_damage_flash.color.a = _damage_flash_alpha


func _show_message(text: String) -> void:
	_message_label.text = text


func _update_hud() -> void:
	if _health_bar == null:
		return
	_health_bar.max_value = max_health
	_health_bar.value = health
	_stamina_bar.max_value = max_stamina
	_stamina_bar.value = stamina
	_ammo_label.text = "%d / %d" % [current_ammo, reserve_ammo]
	_wave_label.text = "Vague %d\nZombies : %d" % [wave_number, _zombies.size() + maxi(0, _zombies_to_spawn - _zombies_spawned_this_wave)]
	_score_label.text = "Score : %d\nTués : %d" % [score, kills]


func get_health_percentage() -> float:
	return health / maxf(1.0, max_health)


func get_remaining_zombies() -> int:
	return _zombies.size() + maxi(0, _zombies_to_spawn - _zombies_spawned_this_wave)


func add_score(points: int) -> void:
	score += points
	_update_hud()
